title: Convai Character
description: A Convai conversational AI character — a reusable agent with voice, backstory, language, personality, knowledge bank, and narrative configuration.

voiceType.description: Voice identifier from the Convai voice catalog

backstory.description: Free-form backstory text shaping the character's identity, role, and behaviour

language.description: BCP-47 style language code, e.g. en-us

isNarrativeDriven.description: Whether the character runs in narrative-driven mode with sections and triggers

knowledgeBank.description: Optional list of attached knowledge bank documents
